record.paper_title: Conjectures and Open Questions on the Structure and Regularity of Spaces with Lower Ricci Curvature Bounds
record.context_brief: full-measure manifold region in collapsed limits
record.original_question: Suppose a sequence of pointed Riemannian manifolds with normalized measures (M_i^n, g_i, ν_i, p_i) converges in the measured Gromov–Hausdorff sense to (X, d, ν, p), with Ric ≥ −λ and Vol(B_1(p_i)) → 0. Does there exist an open subset R(X) ⊆ X of full ν-measure that is homeomorphic to a k-dimensional manifold, where k is the rectifiable dimension of X?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 3.4. Let Mni, gi, νi, pi → (X, d, ν, p) with Ric ≥ −λ and Vol(B1(pi)) → 0, then is there an open subset of full ν-measure R(X) ⊆ X which is homeomorphic to a k-manifold?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\lambda \geq 0$ and let $(M_i^n, g_i, 
u_i, p_i)$ be a sequence of pointed complete $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifolds equipped with normalized measures $
u_i = \mathrm{Vol}(B_1(p_i))^{-1}\,d\mathrm{vol}_{g_i}$, satisfying the uniform lower Ricci curvature bound $\mathrm{Ric}_{g_i} \geq -\lambda$. Assume that $\mathrm{Vol}(B_1(p_i)) 	o 0$ (the collapsed case) and that $(M_i^n, g_i, 
u_i, p_i)$ converges in the pointed measured Gromov–Hausdorff sense to a metric measure space $(X, d, 
u, p)$. It is known that there exists an integer $k$, the rectifiable dimension of $X$, and a $
u$-measurable subset $\mathcal{R}_k(X) \subseteq X$ of full $
u$-measure that is $k$-rectifiable.

Question: Must there exist an open subset $\mathcal{R}(X) \subseteq X$ of full $
u$-measure such that $\mathcal{R}(X)$ is homeomorphic to a topological $k$-dimensional manifold?
artifact.status_search_result: The question has been resolved in the negative. Work by Brué, Naber, and Semola (arXiv:2308.03909, "Lower Ricci Curvature and Nonexistence of Manifold Structure," published in Geometry & Topology, 2025) constructs collapsed Ricci limit spaces, arising as Gromov–Hausdorff limits of smooth manifolds with positive Ricci curvature, that are k-rectifiable but contain no open subset homeomorphic to a topological manifold; in fact every open subset is non-contractible.

status_evidence.title: Lower Ricci Curvature and Nonexistence of Manifold Structure
status_evidence.snippet: We construct a 4-rectifiable metric space arising as a collapsed limit of manifolds with positive Ricci curvature such that every open set U is noncontractible; in particular it has no open subset which is topologically a manifold.
status_evidence.claim: The question is answered negatively: there exist collapsed Ricci limit spaces with no open subset homeomorphic to a manifold.

status_evidence.title: Lower Ricci curvature and nonexistence of manifold structure (Geometry & Topology 2025)
status_evidence.snippet: Published version resolving the open problem on manifold structure of collapsed Ricci limit spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Negative resolution published in Geometry & Topology, vol. 29 (2025).
